**Average House Price in California**

Using the publicly available *California Housing* dataset (the same one used in many machine‑learning tutorials), the **median house value**—which serves as a proxy for “average” market price—is approximately:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Mean Median House Value | **$245 000** |

This figure represents the arithmetic mean of all recorded median house values across the dataset’s 20,640 observations. It gives you a quick sense of what buyers typically pay per unit area when looking at residential properties throughout California.
